text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Opera O-chan, Doto-chan, Ayabe-san, Top Road-san's team~. Wow, what intense aura...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's... Ryan-san and Bright-san. Scheming vibes detected... Time for ninja mode. Nin-nin.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Since it is a Triathlon, wouldn't greater stamina be most desirable~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah! Hey, how about Spe-chan? Feels like she's packing plenty of fuel right now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My, today's heap is practically spilling off the plate~. Fufu, still going back for seconds~. Room for plenty more fuel~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Just as Ryan Onee-sama says, exceptional stamina is assured. Special Week-sama would surely drive us to victory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's go ask once she's done eating! ...Huh? Bright? Hey, what's up?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu, solid fundamentals matter in unfamiliar sports. I have a tiny proposal for you, Onee-sama~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Triathlon... Triathlon... found it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eek?! Ah, Ryan-san! And Bright-san...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Looking up Triathlon guides? Perfect timing! Spe-chan, want to join our team?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? A-Are you scouting me? But why me?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: A hearty eater like you will crush a Triathlon! Plus, you've got great, firm muscles!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Muscles? You can tell just by looking?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ryan Onee-sama can hear the muscles speaking~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, well, I came because I knew you had the goods. What do you say? Team up with us?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um... I'm kind of more interested in the winner's meal vouchers than the race itself, desu_ne...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Then winning's the goal! Works for us! We're aiming for top spot anyway!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Really?! Yay! I'd love to join! I'll do my very best, desu!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan joins Ryan-san's squad! Wow, looks super strong over here too. Star-marked! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu, how is the scouting reconnaissance going~? Matikane Tannhauser♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah-wah! B-Bright-san?! I-I'm totally not scouting, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: If you haven't picked a team yet, would you care to join ours~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Are you sure you didn't mistake me for someone else?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Not at all~. Your diligent daily research and info gathering make you the ideal choice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I truly desire victory. Both as a Mejiro daughter, and for Ryan Onee-sama, to whom I owe so much since childhood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Please lend us your strength. For victory, you are essential.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm... essential... *sniff*!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm honored! If I can help, count me in! I'm just an ordinary girl, but I'll give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The pleasure is all mine. With this lineup, victory is assured~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Kita-chan, Triathlon registration closes today, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Can we really find two more members?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Dia-chan, you—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Wahh! Kyaaa!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so sorry! I wasn't looking where I was going...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it, no harm done! Oh? Are you
two here to enter the triathlon as well?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...U-Um, well... not exactly...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-san, you're here to sign up? Who are your teammates, then?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I am glad you asked! Leg one: Sakura Bakushin O! Leg
two: Sakura Bakushin O! Leg three: Sakura Bakushin
O! And the anchor: Sakura Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ehhh?! Wait, so you're entering all by yourself?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Precisely! I originally invited my classmates to join,
but every single one of them declined!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
They were deeply concerned that a stamina-intensive
triathlon would be far too reckless for me, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I suspect competing alongside their class president
was simply too intimidating for them!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, as class president, I shall conquer this trial alone
to set a sterling example! And so, the one-woman team was
born! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: A-Amazing... What unbeatable mental fortitude...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Is this the kind of boundless courage you gain by
striving at Tracen Academy...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Call it reckless if you must! But it is precisely because
it is a trial that I shall charge ahead, even alone!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Reckless... precisely because it's hard...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan! Let's enter! I want to compete in
the tournament after all!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We finally have a chance to do a school event together!
Even if everyone laughs at us for being rookies, I don't
care! I want to run with you, Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan...! Me too! I want to enter with you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-san! Will you team up with us?
Please let us learn alongside you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We don't have enough members on our own! Please,
we would be honored to have you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Underclassmen in need of aid?! Say no more! Leave
it to me! For I am the class president!

Yo, yo, yoo! Look what we got here! Jackpot!
Now THIS is the kind of squad I was lookin' for!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: G-Golshi-san?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh, lurkin' till the bitter end totally paid off! Who knew such
a delightfully chaotic team would pop up at the final second~?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A clash of raw vibes, a fusion of unknown elements!
I smell a cosmic big bang brewin' here~!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So yeah, consider me your fourth! Treat me well, kiddos!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Yes! We're glad to have you!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: —Splendid! That makes up our final three squads!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Team: T.M. Opera O, Meisho Doto, Admire Vega, Narita Top Road!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Team: Mejiro Ryan, Mejiro Bright, Special
Week, Matikanetannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Team: Sakura Bakushin O, Gold Ship,
Kitasan Black, Satono Diamond!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
With eight teams assembled in total, this anniversary
event is bound to be a magnificent success! Excellent!
